stock_movements_reference_consistency.name: stock_movements_reference_consistency
stock_movements_reference_consistency.value:
("stock_movements"."reference_type" = 'MANUAL' AND "stock_movements"."reference_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("stock_movements"."reference_type" <> 'MANUAL' AND "stock_movements"."reference_id" IS NOT NULL)

stock_opnames_review_fields_consistent.name: stock_opnames_review_fields_consistent
stock_opnames_review_fields_consistent.value:
("stock_opnames"."status" = 'PENDING'
          AND "stock_opnames"."reviewed_by" IS NULL
          AND "stock_opnames"."reviewed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("stock_opnames"."status" IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
          AND "stock_opnames"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_opnames"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

stock_transfers_review_fields_consistent.name: stock_transfers_review_fields_consistent
stock_transfers_review_fields_consistent.value:
("stock_transfers"."status" = 'PENDING'
          AND "stock_transfers"."reviewed_by" IS NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."reviewed_at" IS NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."completed_at" IS NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."cancelled_by" IS NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("stock_transfers"."status" = 'COMPLETED'
          AND "stock_transfers"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."cancelled_by" IS NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("stock_transfers"."status" = 'CANCELLED'
          AND "stock_transfers"."reviewed_by" IS NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."reviewed_at" IS NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."completed_at" IS NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."cancelled_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stock_transfers"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

cashier_shifts_close_fields_consistent.name: cashier_shifts_close_fields_consistent
cashier_shifts_close_fields_consistent.value:
("cashier_shifts"."status" = 'OPEN'
          AND "cashier_shifts"."closed_at" IS NULL
          AND "cashier_shifts"."expected_cash" IS NULL
          AND "cashier_shifts"."actual_cash" IS NULL)
        OR ("cashier_shifts"."status" = 'CLOSED'
          AND "cashier_shifts"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cashier_shifts"."expected_cash" IS NOT NULL
          AND "cashier_shifts"."actual_cash" IS NOT NULL)

sale_returns_refund_fields_consistent.name: sale_returns_refund_fields_consistent
sale_returns_refund_fields_consistent.value:
("sale_returns"."cash_refund" = 0
          AND "sale_returns"."refund_method" IS NULL
          AND "sale_returns"."refunded_at" IS NULL
          AND "sale_returns"."shift_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("sale_returns"."cash_refund" > 0
          AND "sale_returns"."refund_method" IS NOT NULL
          AND "sale_returns"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL)

sale_returns_cash_refund_requires_shift.name: sale_returns_cash_refund_requires_shift
sale_returns_cash_refund_requires_shift.value:
"sale_returns"."refund_method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'CASH'
        OR "sale_returns"."shift_id" IS NOT NULL

sales_void_fields_consistent.name: sales_void_fields_consistent
sales_void_fields_consistent.value:
("sales"."status" = 'COMPLETED'
          AND "sales"."voided_at" IS NULL
          AND "sales"."voided_by" IS NULL
          AND "sales"."void_reason" IS NULL)
        OR ("sales"."status" = 'VOIDED'
          AND "sales"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "sales"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL
          AND "sales"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL)

cash_flows_reference_consistency.name: cash_flows_reference_consistency
cash_flows_reference_consistency.value:
("cash_flows"."source" = 'MANUAL'
          AND "cash_flows"."reference_type" = 'MANUAL'
          AND "cash_flows"."reference_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("cash_flows"."source" = 'AUTO'
          AND "cash_flows"."reference_type" <> 'MANUAL'
          AND "cash_flows"."reference_id" IS NOT NULL)
